title: Breslover Mashpia's Final Wish
body: Rav Binyomin Ze'ev Knopelmacher zt”l, a 75-year-old Breslover mashpia, passed away. His final request was for "dropouts" and "at-risk" youth to carry his aron at his levayah.

title: Rav Yitzchok Dovid Gurwicz
body: Rav Yitzchok Dovid Gurwicz z”l, 90, passed away. Born in England, he was the eldest son of Rav Aryeh Leib Gurwicz zt”l, rosh yeshiva of Yeshivas Bais Yosef in Gateshead.
